name: rustev-conformance-js
description: Spec 027 tooling: the JavaScript conformance runner (Node and headless Chromium), the WebAssembly checks and the document type generator. Never published.
//: Every package in the lockfile, transitive ones included (lodash 4.18.1, js-yaml 4.3.2 and others newer than some references know), is published on the public registry; npm ci checks each against its locked integrity, and make bindings verifies every installed package's registry signature (npm audit signatures). playwright-core is exact-pinned and has no dependencies; make bindings installs the headless Chromium build that version pins, from Playwright's download host, and drives it only on a loopback server.
